CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, July 19, 2023, 2023 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 21, 2023 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  July 19, 2023
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item IV
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, June 21, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:00 P.M. on Wednesday, June 21, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Hermano.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Jimenez and Commission Member
Massaro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR THE 2023-2024 TERM
President Canseco
Vice President Saunders

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE APRIL 19, 2023 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE MAY 11, 2023 SPECIAL C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the minutes
from the April 19, 2023 regular and May 11, 2023 special meeting were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Commission Members are researching possible concepts and locations for their Alhambra
District Art Project.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton shared event flyers and invited the City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission to attend Alhambra’s Fourth of July celebration, Alhambra Park’s Movies and
Concerts in the Park.

Deputy Director Houghton presented CSC Health Regional Center’s public art project
application to the Commission and received their recommendation to CSC Health Regional
Center to revise their proposed design to better represent the narrative and include a placard on
site to encourage community engagement.
 Deputy Director Houghton informed the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission the 2024
Rose Parade Float Design was approved by Alhambra City Council at the last City Council
meeting.

With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission approved Kimberly Ann Talbert and Joan Whitmore’s art
exhibition for August 2023 and Verdugo Hills for April 2024.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Christina Chahine recommends creating an Arts Initiative for decorated utility boxes throughout
Alhambra. Vice President Saunders agreed to contact and introduce City Council Member Perez
and Mayor Andrade-Stadler to Ms. Chahine to discuss her ideas.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
President Canseco shared the concept of building and window wraps to beautify and transform
vacant buildings with art for upcoming community events and holidays. Commission Member
Hermano shared that she is familiar with the product and could obtain a sample roll for the City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission to experiment with.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and second by Commission Member Hermano, the
June 21, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:49 P.M.
